translation.ve_studyGoldDots: Study the gold dots below — they show where the notes are on the fretboard.
translation.ve_studyPattern: Study the pattern! You have a few seconds before it disappears.
translation.ve_patternVanished: The pattern just vanished — get ready to tap!
translation.ve_tapNotes: Tap where the notes were — trust your imagination!
translation.ve_howToPlayImagine: ❶ Study the gold dots — they show notes in the scale. ❷ Tap the same positions. ❸ Hold and breathe steadily until the timer completes.
translation.ve_howToPlayFlash: ❶ Gold dots flash on the fretboard — study positions! ❷ The pattern disappears. ❸ Tap from memory. ❹ Green = correct, Red = wrong, Orange = missed.
translation.ve_menuSubtitle: Train the imagination. The fingers follow.
translation.ve_vertiscaleDesc1: A vertiscale is a vertical scale shape on the guitar neck. Instead of playing a scale horizontally (across frets), you play it vertically (across strings in the same fret area).
translation.ve_vertiscaleDesc2: This teaches you to see patterns in all directions — the foundation of fretboard mastery.
translation.ve_vertiscaleDesc3: Don’t worry if you’re new — the game starts simple (just 2 strings) and gradually adds more.
translation.ve_slowDesc: Pattern stays 3.5s — focus on physical memory
translation.ve_innerFretboardDesc: Train your visual memory of where notes live on the guitar neck
translation.ve_flashDesc: A pattern of notes flashes on the fretboard. Study it carefully — then it disappears! Tap from your imagination to recreate where the notes were.
translation.ve_imagineDesc: The pattern stays visible while you place your taps. Focus on accuracy and steady breathing.
translation.ve_innerEarDesc: Develop your ability to hear and match pitches
translation.ve_audiateDesc: A note falls down the screen. Try to hear it in your mind first, then sing it.
translation.ve_innerVoiceDesc: Reflect on what your practice sessions reveal
translation.ve_reflectDesc: Review your session performance. See where you were accurate, where you struggled, and journal about what you noticed.
translation.ve_livingStoryDesc: Learn through an immersive historical narrative
translation.ve_adventureDesc: Play through a historical story as a medieval truebadour. At key moments, you must match a musical pitch to unlock the next chapter.
translation.ve_hearInMind: Hear the note in your mind. Don’t sing yet…
translation.ve_fhealPlaceholder:

translation.quest_1_flavor: Before you can play, you must learn to breathe. The journey begins not with the guitar, but with you.
translation.quest_2_flavor: Every musician resists at first. The Practice Timer teaches you to show up even when inspiration doesn't.
translation.quest_3_flavor: In the Pitch Room, you meet the first true teacher: your own ear. Learn to listen before you play.
translation.quest_4_flavor: You step beyond listening into creating. Truebadour awaits with quill in hand, ready to help you write your first song.
translation.quest_5_flavor: The intervals are your first real test. Some will feel like allies; others will challenge everything you know.
translation.quest_6_flavor: The Grid Map reveals the hidden geometry of the fretboard. Five shapes, one truth: CAGED.
translation.quest_7_flavor: PLING! — the moment voice meets string. Sing the note, find it on the guitar. This is the somatic crucible.
translation.quest_8_flavor: Your ear has grown precise enough to hear cents. The Microtonal Tracker reveals the expressive nuance in every bend.
translation.quest_9_flavor: The full 12-fret guitar neck unfolds before you. Every note is now a friend. Explore freely.
translation.quest_10_flavor: Record yourself and send it to Bertrand. This is the moment you become accountable to your art.
translation.quest_11_flavor: You can now see any scale across all 12 keys simultaneously. The grid is alive in your mind.
translation.quest_12_flavor: The final fret. You channel freely over backing tracks, voice and guitar united. The song and the player are one.

translation.stampPlingText: 🎸 {{somaticPling}} Metaphor: 'Ensure you listen for the absolute PLING! resonance—feel the note ring out fully with zero somatic grip.'
translation.stampShearlText: 🕊️ {{somaticShearl}} Metaphor: 'Apply the SHEARL glide here—let your fingers glide horizontally like a feather, bypassing frets without neck friction.'
translation.stampFhealText: 🕯️ {{somaticFheal}} Metaphor: 'Try the FHEAL recovery—drop your left shoulder down, let the hand breathe, and allow your muscle memory to speak.'
